objective: Pin the exact insertion points of the admission decision in the CURRENT graph lifecycle so TA-2 can wire enforcement to existing seams (no new parallel machinery).

answers.admission_before_or_after_decomposition: BEFORE decomposition. Admission decides decomposition requirement + depth bound + research gate. The fast path (no decomposition, direct execution) is itself an admission output. Decomposition's IR execution_policy is CONSTRAINED by admission (no model routing; multi_model_orchestration=false stays).
answers.which_classifications_need_preliminary_d: size dimensions affected_files / affected_subsystems / dependency_depth and any risk signal whose evidence is ambiguous. Preliminary discovery = read-only exploration (CAP.READONLY_SUBAGENT) or memory retrieval, producing a BOUNDED refinement (once) before mutation.
answers.bounded_refinement_allowed: exactly once, before any mutation; refinement preserves risk monotonicity; after freeze, drift = HOLD.
answers.authoritative_decision_owner: a dedicated admission module (TA-2: src/admission/*) — the ONLY writer of admission records. Scheduler/sub-agents/writers/reviewers CONSUME it; none may amend it. Controller may issue a bounded re-admission (new decision, supersedes old, logged) for CRITICAL tasks only.
answers.scheduler_consumption: runColimaGraph / runSubagentGraph / runDurableGraph accept the admission record (or its digest) at entry; node-role grants (readonly-analyst/writer/reviewer/repairer/verifier/join) and repair_budget come from admission; graph refuses to run with a missing/malformed admission (fail-closed).
answers.subagent_consumption: subagent-contract envelope builder fills toolPermissions + mutationScope from admission.capabilities + isolation_policy; envelope identity hash covers admission digest so a changed admission invalidates in-flight envelopes.
answers.writer_reviewer_enforcement: writer adapter enforces mutationScope from admission (existing fail-closed contract); reviewer adapter enforces review strength + strict routing from admission; a writer under a read-only admission is structurally unable to gain write capability (NEG3).
answers.durable_execution_persistence: admission record (admission_id + digest) is persisted with the checkpoint; checkpoint fingerprint includes admission_id.
answers.checkpoint_resume_anti_drift: on resume, re-hash the admission payload; admission_id mismatch -> HOLD / ADMISSION_DRIFT (never silently re-classify).
answers.review_bundle_recording: the closeout source records admission_id + size + risk + profile + capability sets + reasons (self-contained; no chat dependence). The bundle's inventory consistency (FM-3 delta-v1) covers admission artifacts as implementation/closeout outputs.
answers.telemetry_measurement: telemetry events (node.run / graph.run) carry admission_id + profile; aggregates compute admission quality: overkill_rate (heavy profile, trivial outcome), under_classification_rate (fast-path task that later required repair/escalation), escalation_frequency; budgets (simulated today) may later select budget by profile.

insertionSequence: 1. task intake -> parent-card binding -> lifecycle authority record resolved
2. ADMISSION: classify size + risk + profile + capabilities (deterministic; evidence reasons)
3. conflict check vs authority record (subset; else HOLD / AUTHORITY_CONFLICT)
4. research gate (if research_first_required): read-only discovery -> bounded refinement (once)
5. decomposition (if decomposition_required) with admission-constrained execution_policy; fast path skips to direct execution
6. graph execution: scheduler consumes admission; sub-agent envelopes built from admission; writer/reviewer enforce
7. durable layer persists admission; resume verifies admission_id
8. closeout: review bundle records admission; external review when required; telemetry aggregates quality

capabilityAliases.note: policy-level ids used in admission records must resolve to registry capability ids (CAP.*) for machine verification (NEG4). 'direct_execution' is a virtual capability meaning 'run without the graph scheduler'; it grants no tool access. 'fast_path' is a PROFILE marker, not a capability, and must never appear in capability arrays.

newModulesForTA2: src/admission/admission-record.mjs (schema validation + admission_id derivation + freeze + drift check)
src/admission/registry.mjs (capability registry: ids + required input permissions + side effects + when-not hints, mirroring ta1-capability-usage-matrix.json)
noNewMachinery: admission REUSES: risk-normalization.mjs (risk axis), sub-agent envelope (capability enforcement surface), mutationScope (writer scope), effective_repair_cap (repair budget), checkpoint fingerprint (freeze), review bundle + fixed surface (review), telemetry (measurement). No new isolation, no new persistence, no new review channel.
